name: Marker reflection (example)
description: Adds an X-Marker header to requests, reports responses that echo it, drops /blocked requests; shows counters in its own tab. The API v1 walkthrough.

name: Security headers review
description: Passive review of HTML responses for missing Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options and frame protection; one informational issue per host and header, per-host summary tab.

name: Montoya demo (Java)
description: A real Burp Montoya extension run in the sidecar JVM: tags requests and responses with headers and drops /admin-drop paths.
